responsibility: This file performs front-end dependency and overlap analysis on expressions, especially array references and function calls relevant to assignment scalarization and temporary creation. It compares variables, sections, subscripts, substrings, and elemental references for equality, directionality, overlap, and loop-reversal opportunities, and provides helpers used by transformation and lowering code to decide when array temporaries or special execution order are required to preserve Fortran semantics.
same_name_distinction: Contains the expression and array-reference overlap analysis logic itself, including equality/overlap tests, section comparison, and loop-reversal decisions used when preserving assignment semantics. Unlike gcc/fortran/dependency.h, it performs the dependency reasoning rather than just declaring it.
